data.content:
## [Ordering was easy and items arrived within the timeframe provided](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6451ccfe734f97e68fa9e121)
Ordering was easy and communication was timely and not too much. The items were well packaged and received within the range listed on the product page. Fed-ex dropped our order off on Saturday. They dropped our ottomans off in front of our garage in plain sight of every passer by when we have privacy fences just several steps away. We had to ask our neighbor to place the boxes (ottomans) behind our privacy fence. Please pass this along to your shipping partner. The ottomans I ordered exceeded my expectation. We recently changed nearly all the furniture and rug in our living room. We ordered from another well known brand and tried L and G for the first time. The ottomans have been the best items we purchased in this redo. Aside from Fed-ex everything was pleasant. I will definitely order from Lulu and Georgia again.

March 23, 2023
